28081.notes: Mississippi tax-sale (certificate-to-deed path) county. Lee County Tax Collector auctions unpaid taxes online via GovEase. Sale always last Monday in August beginning ~9:00 a.m. (statute window; historically multi-day). Registration on GovEase opens August 1. Starting bid = taxes and penalty; overbids discouraged (no interest on overbid; overbid not returned on redemption). Two-year redemption; then tax deed application via Chancery Clerk (662-432-2100). Redemption pays base taxes/penalty (excluding overbid) + 1.5% interest. Advertised in Northeast MS Daily Journal two consecutive weeks after August 5. Tupelo / Northeast Mississippi market.

54107.notes: West Virginia hybrid tax-lien-to-deed county. Wood County Sheriff’s Tax Office collects RE taxes; real estate remaining delinquent as of October 31 is certified to the State of West Virginia for later sale by the State Deputy Land Commissioner (WV State Auditor County Collections — wvsao.gov/countycollections). County sheriff tax lien sales historically ran live in spring cycles; state process handles certified lands with online bid windows when lists post. Purchaser path is lien → notice to redeem → tax deed, not same-day fee title. Two weeks before any local delinquent tax sale, only cashier’s check, money order, or cash accepted for delinquent payments. Parkersburg / Vienna Mid-Ohio Valley market.

Payment typically check/money order to sheriff of the county for land sales per state rules; confirm exact deposit and same-day payment requirements on the live notice. Track strict notice-to-redeem deadlines after lien purchase before applying for deed.
